title: Remove duplicate Vietnamese localization keys
context: A static audit of the Vietnamese Localizable.strings catalog found seven duplicate keys with identical values, which can create ambiguous localization lookup and compiler warnings.
goal: Keep exactly one definition per localization key in the Vietnamese strings catalog while preserving the first existing translation for each key.
forbidden_changes: Do not change translation values or English localization.
Do not remove any unique localization key.
Do not change SwiftUI behavior or runtime code.
acceptance_criteria: The seven identified duplicate keys each appear exactly once.
All existing Vietnamese translation values remain unchanged.
The catalog contains no duplicate keys after the edit.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Run a duplicate-key scan against the Vietnamese strings file
recovery: Revert the single task commit if any unique localization entry is lost or the Apple build fails.
